title: Bank-Fraud-detection
summary: A Jupyter notebook project for detecting fraudulent bank transactions, using the standalone ctgan package to train a CTGANSynthesizer on tabular data for synthetic data generation. CTGAN (from the SDV family) is imported directly and fit on the dataset, not accessed through SDV's sdv.* API.
